author: Sai
install_msg: Thanks for installing TradingCards. Start with `[p]tcg sets`, then refresh cache with `[p]tcgset refreshsets`.
name: TCG
short: Pokémon-style trading card collecting, trading, and member marketplace
description: A Red Discord bot cog for a Pokémon TCG-inspired collection game with API-backed card data, pack opening simulation, direct member trades, and player-driven card marketplace pricing.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-guild game settings, set cache metadata, active trades/listings, and bounded trade/sale history, plus per-member owned card instances, unopened packs, favorites, pull stats, and counters.
